headline: Morgan Stanley Warns Semiconductor Stock Support May Drop 15%
summary: Morgan Stanley's chief stock-market strategist warned that support for semiconductor stocks could fall as much as 15% from current levels despite maintaining a year-end S&P 500 target.
why: Morgan Stanley is a major global financial institution whose equity research and sector calls influence institutional portfolio allocations.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Negative commentary from prominent Wall Street strategists can induce institutional profit-taking and lower sector valuations.

why_moved: A prominent Wall Street strategist forecasting a pullback in key tech sectors caused investors to reassess valuations and trim high-flying semiconductor holdings.
